headline: Reviewed proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy and approved minutes from 9/11/2026 and 9/18/2026.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee discussed a proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy, covering questions about whether roads and sidewalks count as school property, equity concerns, and possible regulation through MPD or a city ordinance. The subcommittee also reviewed an Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy and recommendations for Sections J and K, but recorded no discussion on these. Minutes from 9/11/2026 and 9/18/2026 were approved.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Member McCarthy Sirois made a motion to accept the minutes for 9/11/2026. Member Baez seconded the motion. Passed 3-0
MOTION: Member McCarthy Sirois made a motion to accept the minutes for 9/18/2026. Member Keegan seconded the motion. Passed 3-0
